turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Here is the rule. Before one thing (a singular noun) we always put a or an: "a book", not "book". Use an before a vowel sound (an apple, an egg) and a before a consonant sound (a cat, a dog).

Look at this pair. Right: "My brother is a doctor." Wrong: "My brother is doctor."

Now write one sentence of your own about something in your bag. Use a or an.
